detail.longDescription: I've also grown rather fond of # Git ⁠'s staging feature. I was skeptical when I first learned of it, but being able to do a half-commit (i.e. `git add` a change) before continuing on makes it easier to review my work before I actually commit it. And of course I'm fond of version control in general. Being able to see exactly what I've changed since last commit is a great way to catch typos and other mistakes. # programming
